jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET / Azure)
jobs.description:
Remuneration Package: Up to $9,000
Position: Permanent Role with Attractive Variable Bonus
Working Location: Central near MRT Station
Key Requirements: Experiences in web application development using .NET frameworks and familiar with Vue.js, Angular or React

We are assisting our client, an established international shipping organisation in hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer. With a global presence, the company connects regional ports to major shipping hubs and supports the movement of cargo across international markets.

This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on developer who enjoys solving technical challenges, building reliable applications and collaborating with an international team.

Why Join?

Attractive basic salary of S$9,000 per month.
Permanent opportunity with an established global maritime organisation.
Exposure to web development, modern frontend frameworks and Azure.
Contribute to application development and continuous improvement supporting shipping operations.

Key Responsibilities

Analyse business requirements and translate them into application features and technical solutions.
Write high-quality, maintainable code in line with development best practices and project timelines.
Develop new product features and improve existing applications.
Debug and troubleshoot application issues to support reliable system performance.
Conduct and support functional and non-functional testing before release.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation and user handbooks.
Collaborate with the software delivery team within an Agile Scrum environment.

Key Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in web application development using .NET frameworks.
Minimum 2 years of experience with modern frontend frameworks, such as Vue.js, Angular or React.
Experience with message queues such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS.
Experience with Azure, Git source control and Agile Scrum methodology.
Knowledge of parallel programming, optimisation and microservices will be an advantage.
Strong troubleshooting skills, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
A collaborative, responsible and self-motivated approach, with the ability to work independently.

Interested candidates can forward their CVs in MS Word format to weiyan@triton-ai.com

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary

Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.

This is not a order-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.

Key Responsibilities

Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI-enabled solutions.
Build and deploy agentic AI systems end-to-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.
In Studios: take use cases from prototype to production-grade agentic systems with the engineering rigour that implies.
In Products: configure and deploy pre-built agentic products into client environments.
Design on the Avanade Agentic Platform and the Microsoft AI stack, choosing the right combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and AAP for the business problem.
Apply AI-native engineering practices — agent-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
Work with Trust Architects on evaluation, accuracy and guardrails as part of the build, not as a later gate.
Work with Value Architects so what is built stays connected to the measurable outcome it was funded for.
Contribute reusable components, patterns and assets to the APAC IP library and the Avanade Agentic Platform on every engagement.
Operate with high autonomy in the client's environment, including in the ambiguity of early-stage discovery.

KEY MEASURES

Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
Production-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
Demonstrable productivity through AI-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.
Accuracy and evaluation thresholds met before release.

Qualifications

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

5+ years in software or AI engineering, with production systems to point to.
Strong practical command of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and agent orchestration; equivalent depth on another stack considered if the transfer is credible.
Full-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole.
Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.
Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else.
Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.

Show more

Show less

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

jobs.title: Senior FullStack Engineer (Python+.Net)
jobs.description:
About The Role

In this role, you'll build the backend services that keep critical infrastructure data moving accurately and reliably. Working across Python and .NET, you'll design and deliver data processing systems for energy sector clients, partnering closely with architects and engineers to turn complex requirements into dependable, production-ready solutions.

Responsibilities

Design and develop backend applications using Python (FastAPI) and .NET (ASP.NET Core) that power data processing pipelines for energy infrastructure clients
Improve system performance and reliability by optimizing event-driven architectures built on Kafka and containerized deployments managed with Helm Charts
Collaborate closely with architects, QA engineers, and client stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, production-ready solutions
Build and maintain .NET services using EF Core, async programming, and REST APIs, ensuring code quality, maintainability, and adherence to client IT standards
Apply test-driven development practices to deliver reliable, well-tested code across both Python and .NET codebases
Take part in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, to plan and deliver work iteratively
Contribute to code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices to maintain high delivery quality
Troubleshoot and resolve issues across distributed systems, minimizing disruption to services that handle critical data

Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of experience delivering IT solutions aligned with client IT strategy and standards
Hands-on experience with Python, FastAPI, Kafka, and Helm Charts
Practical experience with .NET 8+, EF Core, TDD, async programming, REST APIs, and authentication/authorization
Working knowledge of Agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills in distributed, data-intensive systems
Clear communication skills for collaborating with cross-functional and client teams
Experience with Kubernetes, Argo CD, Protobuf, Pydantic, or Grafana
Background in electrical engineering, or experience with transmission system operators or comparable energy infrastructure companies
Familiarity with SCADA, PMU, PQ, protection, or fault record data
Experience working in critical infrastructure environments
Strong communication skills

SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship, disability, health condition, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, Unified Content Processing Platform
jobs.description:
Description

Deliver AI Innovation in Compliance at Amazon

Join a team building the future of automated compliance in the product space. Your work will directly impact Amazon's ability to serve customers and partners safely and efficiently across the globe.

We have a unique challenge to overcome: use ML and LLMs at the scale of Amazon. As a software development engineer you will develop scalable LLM infrastructure that can be used to process billions of documents and images each year, in a cost efficient way.

The ideal candidate will be eager to work in a team of innovators and contribute to a suite of tools that power automating and scalable content processing with the end goal of providing Amazon shoppers and sellers with a frictionless and trustworthy shopping and selling experience. You will be working in an Agile mode, collaborating with product management and partner teams to iterate at a fast pace and delight our end users.

Key job responsibilities

Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

designing, developing and maintaining distributed systems hosted in AWS;
guiding a team of engineers in writing maintainable code and adhering to operational practices;
defining idiomatic solutions for processing varied types of content with diverse ML solutions and application integrations;
improving performance and operational costs;
researching solutions for technically ambiguous problems.

A day in the life

As senior software engineer’s day typically involves designing or researching technical solutions and alternatives to your team’s most critical and complex features and projects. As a team leader, you will also review your peers’ code and dive deep into their design documents to provide feedback on software architecture, scalability and security. You will code the critical code path in your projects and coordinate with peers on the tasks that you delegated to them. You advise your manager on trade-offs and product future direction.

About The Team

Compliance Safety Services (CoSS) vision is to provide best-in-class automation of controls for internal compliance and business programs (our primary customers) to lower costs in the Amazon flywheel on behalf of our end customers: buyers and selling partners. We provide easy-to-use shared services with data privacy, security and tenant isolation across all stages, while continuously raising industry standards for automation performance and cost efficiency, giving our program customers confidence that they have access to optimal cost-efficient automation options to better serve their end customers.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
